simulations.title: ME/CFS Outbreak Simulator
simulations.description: Agent-based population simulation tracking viral outbreak and post-viral ME/CFS conversion across 100 individuals, with 25+ calibrated risk factors and brainstem ANS dynamics.

simulations.title: Emergence / Flocking
simulations.description: Each agent follows three simple local rules: avoid neighbours, align with nearby headings, and move toward nearby centres. No agent sees the global pattern — the flock emerges from purely local interactions.

simulations.title: Feedback Loops
simulations.description: Reinforcing loops amplify change (exponential growth or collapse). Balancing loops resist change and seek equilibrium. Most complex systems are networks of both.

simulations.title: Lorenz Attractor
simulations.description: Three linked differential equations produce a trajectory that never repeats — yet stays bounded in a butterfly-shaped region of phase space. Tiny differences in starting position lead to completely different futures.
